title: 第十二章、游戏结束，队友反水，内讧产生
slug: 末日求生欧皇女配在线摇人
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

端木棠梨微微愣神，就在众人欢声雀跃中惊醒过来，嘴角上扬，兴奋说，“跳跃，闪烁，挥拐重击，可爱的小积木们乖乖给我滚下来，成为我变强的垫脚木。”

“恭喜端木棠梨成功击倒原木积木，获得三十秒积木叠叠高入场券。”

“恭喜端木棠梨成功击倒原木积木，获得三秒定时骰子。”

“恭喜端木棠梨成功击倒原木积木，获得一分钟积木叠叠高入场券。”

“恭喜端木棠梨成功击倒原木积木，获得积木叠叠高技能一份书。”

端木棠梨越玩越嗨皮，看都不看自己抽打积木属于哪个颜色挥拐出击，只要能触发百分百击倒效果，不管多厉害的积木属性都能被其击倒。

相反端木棠梨要是顾东顾西思考太多，反而容易浪费本就不多的时间，导致获得积木叠叠高入场券不够数。

在极短的三分钟时间内，端木棠梨靠着黑红浮空伞极限跳跃上百次，挥出上百次重击拐杖，收获了八十张积木叠叠高入场券，三枚定时骰子，七份积木叠叠高技能书，金木水火土异能球每种三份，总共105份战利品。

之前大伙团结一起才摧毁八个积木，看看现在端木棠梨一个人就击倒上百个积木，真是人比人，气死人，货比货，得扔。

“来来，大小姐请坐下，让老奴给你捶捶背。”

老六见端木棠梨停下攻击动作，狗腿跑上前对大小姐大献殷勤，惹得米樱昭雪不满狂射眼刀子。

“我说老六，刚才你不是还觉得我家大小姐不配当你队长，想要踹掉大小姐，换你三哥上位。”

米樱昭雪阴阳怪气说。

好气，这家伙比她还狗，小梨子不会更喜欢这人，不喜欢她吧！

不行，不能让这个狗腿子上位，抢了她大姐大的身份，必须摁死这家伙。

“哎呀，我真该死，居然瞎了眼，没看不出大小姐你是天之骄女，老天爷赏饭吃的大佬。”

老六是个狠人，不知嘴巴上说说而已，手上还十分用力给了自己两大耳光，硬生生将自己打成大猪头。

就连满眼嫉妒的米樱昭雪看到老六将自己脸打成大猪头，都不好意思继续为难对方，可就这么放过对方，又觉得心里堵着慌，不由小声嘟囔，“至于下这么狠手，不知道还以为是我家大小姐心眼小，将你打得面目全非，这不是害我家大小姐名声扫地。”

“不是的，大小姐，我没这么想，你要相信我。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Duanmu Tangli was stunned for a moment, then woke up amidst the cheers of the crowd. He raised the corners of his mouth and said excitedly, "Jump, flash, swing and hit hard. The cute little blocks will roll down obediently for me and become stepping stones for me to become stronger."

"Congratulations to Duanmu Tangli for successfully knocking down the wooden blocks and winning the thirty-second block stacking ticket."

"Congratulations to Duanmu Tangli for successfully knocking down the wooden blocks and obtaining the three-second timed dice."

"Congratulations to Duanmu Tangli for successfully knocking down the log blocks and winning the one-minute stacking block ticket."

"Congratulations to Duanmu Tangli for successfully knocking down the wooden blocks and obtaining a book on the high skill of stacking blocks."

The more Duanmu Tangli played, the more excited he became. He would strike out with his crutch without even looking at the color of the blocks he was whipping. As long as the 100% knockdown effect could be triggered, no matter how powerful the attributes of the blocks were, they could be knocked down.

On the contrary, if Duanmu Tangli thinks too much, he will easily waste his limited time and not get enough Jenga tickets.

In a very short period of three minutes, Duanmu Tangli jumped hundreds of times with the black and red floating umbrella, swung the cane hundreds of times, and harvested 80 Jenga tickets, three timed dice, seven Jenga skill books, and three gold, wood, water, fire, and earth power balls, for a total of 105 trophies.

Before, everyone worked together to destroy only eight blocks, but now Duanmu Tangli knocked down hundreds of blocks by himself. It was so frustrating and infuriating that Duanmu Tangli had to throw it away.

"Come on, Miss, please sit down and let me rub your back."

When Lao Liu saw Duanmu Tangli stop attacking, he ran forward and showed great courtesy to the eldest lady, which made Mi Ying Zhaoxue shoot his eyes and knives wildly in dissatisfaction.

"Let me tell you, Sixth Brother, didn't you just think that my eldest daughter is not worthy of being your captain, and you want to kick her out and replace your third brother with yours."

Mi Yingzhaoxue said in a strange tone.

So angry, this guy is worse than her. Little Lizi doesn’t like this guy more than she does!

No, we can't let this bitch take over and steal her identity as the eldest sister. We must kill this guy.

"Oh, damn it, I'm so blind that I couldn't see that, eldest lady, you are the proud daughter of God, the boss whom God rewards with food."

Lao Liu was a cruel person. He just said what he said, but he also slapped himself twice hard with his hands, and beat himself into a big pig's head.

Even Mi Ying Zhaoxue, who was full of jealousy, was embarrassed to continue to embarrass the other party when she saw Lao Liu beating her face into a big pig's head. But she let the other party go, and felt panicked in her heart. She couldn't help but mutter in a low voice, "As for being so cruel, I don't know if I thought it was my eldest lady who was petty. I beat you beyond recognition. Isn't this bringing my eldest lady's reputation into disrepute?"

"No, Miss, I don't think so, you have to believe me."
